tytul: Rosemary and garlic oil for the refrigerator, eaten by the next day (UGA method, BfR limit)
wstep: This card uses the UGA Extension method for oil with non-acidified garlic and herbs, here fresh rosemary and garlic: the oil is heated to 180 °F (82 °C) before they are added, and the oil is kept in the refrigerator. UGA allows at most 4 days in the refrigerator, and NCHFP gives no more than 4 days for garlic in oil. This card uses the shorter limit of the German Federal Institute for Risk Assessment (BfR): eat the oil no later than the day after you make it.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Home-made oils with non-acidified garlic or herbs must never be stored at room temperature.
For garlic in oil, NCHFP says to make it fresh and keep it in the refrigerator at 40 °F (4.4 °C) or lower for no more than 4 days.

akapity: Vegetables and herbs in oil meet the conditions for botulinum toxin production: spores can be present, oil keeps oxygen out, and the pH is above 4.6.
You cannot tell from the look, smell or taste of the oil whether botulism is a risk.

UGA also describes a tested method that acidifies garlic and rosemary before they go into oil, so that the oil can be kept at room temperature; this card does not use it and keeps the oil in the refrigerator.
Do not try to acidify the garlic or rosemary with vinegar or lemon juice: they have not been tested and may give an unsafe product.
Using dried garlic or herbs instead does not ensure a safe oil: without a laboratory measurement you cannot know whether dried herbs are dry enough.
This card gives no method for freezing the oil.
Make only as much oil as you will eat by the day after you make it.
Wash the glass container thoroughly and boil it for 10 minutes.
Choose good-quality rosemary and garlic, wash them thoroughly and pat them dry.
Heat the oil to 180 °F (82 °C) and only then add the rosemary and garlic; JarAtlas advises checking the temperature with a kitchen thermometer.
Put the oil with the rosemary and garlic into the sterilized container, close it and keep it in the refrigerator.
Keep the oil in the refrigerator at 40 °F (4 °C) or lower.
Eat the oil no later than the day after you made it, and throw away what is left.
The BfR advises against making herb oils in advance and storing them at home.
